reproducibility_gaps: No repository license was identified at the authoritative Stage-2 snapshot.

The README instructs pip installation from requirements.txt, but the manifest mixes entries that are not valid ordinary pip requirement specifications, so the environment is not statically reconstructable from the documented command.
The README prose names data_prep.py while the command and pinned tree use data_gen.py.
The RBC dataset is external and was not downloaded or loaded.
No released trained checkpoint was verified.
No fixed machine-readable numerical acceptance target was verified.
notes: R1 is conservative because detailed source, preprocessing, training, seed and evaluation surfaces are inspectable but the documented installation manifest is internally inconsistent with the pip command and licensing is unavailable.
